newsitem.title: ITALY: Election results from Italian mayoral races.
newsitem.headline: Election results from Italian mayoral races.

text.p: Following are percentages of the vote won by Italian parties in weekend mayoral races in more than 1,100 cities and towns.
A second round run-off will take place in May 11 in some 100 large centres where no candidate was able to secure more than 50 percent of the vote.
No comparisons with past relevant local elections were available.

+++CENTRE-LEFT PARTIES AND LISTS+++ Democratic Party of the Left (PDS) 17.0, Communist Refoundation 7.9, Popular Party (PPI) 6.2, Italian Renewal 1.8, Greens 1.7, Republican Party 0.6, Olive Tree Coalition 1.6, Leftist List 1.7, Centre-Left List 4.7, Centrist List 4.1

+++CENTRE-RIGHT PARTIES AND LISTS+++ Forza Italia (FI) 9.6, CDC 3.2, CDU 2.0, CDC+CDU coalition 0.8, National Alliance 12.0, Centre-Right List 1.3, MSI (Neo Fascists) 0.6, Centre-right civic lists 3. -- Rome Newsroom ++396-6782501
